description: Fetches profile data from Linktree (linktr.ee) including profile info, social links, and all link items.

function.description:
要调用的功能名。可用值:
  - get_profile: Fetch a Linktree profile by username; requires 'username' param; 参数: username; 必填: 无

username.description: Linktree username to fetch (e.g., 'itsmetinx', '@bretmanrock', or full URL 'https://linktr.ee/paigedesorbo_demo'). Used by get_profile.
